differences.what: Overall color grade and key light are wrong: capture is cold blue-grey and underlit everywhere except the cafe; reference is dominated by warm amber/orange (2200-2700K) light, with pink and cyan neon only as accents.
differences.where: Whole frame, worst on the left half (stairs, bridge, sidewalk) and the sky/towers
differences.fix: Make warm tungsten practicals the key light: raise the warm emissive and point/spot intensities about 3-5x, cut the blue ambient/fill to near zero, and lower the exposure on the cyan sky fill. Grade toward orange midtones with deep blue-black shadows and add bloom so warm sources halo like the reference.

differences.what: Left staircase is flat, untextured slate-blue geometry with no lighting; the reference has dark wet wood steps, a warm LED strip glowing under every step nosing, and plants and lanterns along the side.
differences.where: Left foreground, the stair that runs from bottom-left up to the bridge
differences.fix: Give the steps a dark stained wood material with wet specular. Add an emissive warm-orange strip under each tread nosing so each step casts a horizontal glow line. Add potted ferns and ivy on the outer stringer and a lit handrail.

differences.what: The elevated walkway is a bare grey concrete box with flat panel railings. The reference is a lush terrace: string lights with colored bulbs, hanging paper lanterns with a water-drop logo, wisteria and ivy spilling over the edge, a cyan neon strip along the underside fascia, and a pink neon coffee-cup sign.
differences.where: Upper center-left, the horizontal bridge spanning the frame
differences.fix: Replace the solid panels with a dark metal railing. Hang catenary string lights (warm white plus a few red, green and blue bulbs) and 4-5 glowing white paper lanterns with the drop emblem above the deck. Drape ivy and purple wisteria down the fascia. Add a cyan emissive line along the underside edge and a pink neon coffee-cup sign at the bridge's right end.

differences.what: The left building face is a blank grey wall with an odd RGB logo. The reference shows a tall warm-lit glass storefront with plants inside, a large white paper lantern with a water-drop emblem, and a chalkboard A-frame reading テラス席 with an up arrow.
differences.where: Far left edge, from foreground to midground
differences.fix: Model floor-to-ceiling mullioned glass with a bright warm interior (emissive plus interior plants). Hang a large glowing cylindrical paper lantern at about head height with the drop logo, and add a black chalkboard A-frame sign 'テラス席 ↑' with potted plants at the stair base. Remove the RGB logo.

differences.what: The road reads as a flooded, choppy pool with heavy wave distortion and blocky smeared reflections, and the crosswalk stripes look like raised floating slabs. The reference is flat wet asphalt: a thin water film, long vertical mirror streaks of every light, and painted stripes flush with the road.
differences.where: Center to right foreground, the road and crosswalk
differences.fix: Make the asphalt flat, dark and high-gloss (roughness about 0.05-0.15) with only subtle normal ripples. Use SSR or planar reflections stretched vertically into long streaks. Flatten the crosswalk to painted white stripes flush with the road, glossy and wet, with no thickness or gaps showing water under them. Remove the canal-like water body along the left curb.

differences.what: The 茶房雫 vertical pink neon sign is missing. Instead a blown-out cyan-white rectangular glow sits at the top of the cafe and washes the area in teal.
differences.where: Upper right, above and right of the cafe building
differences.fix: Replace the cyan block with a vertical sign of hot-pink neon kanji 茶房雫 on a dark backing, mounted to the right of the cafe facade. Keep bloom moderate and add a few smaller cyan and purple vertical signs on the distant towers for accent.

differences.what: The background convenience store is dim and generic, with blank white panels and no branding. The reference has a bright ほしマート store with an orange/blue/white striped fascia band, a star logo, and a brightly lit interior spilling light onto the street.
differences.fix: Add a white sign band with orange and blue stripes and the text '★ほしマート', and fill the glass front with bright, cool-white lit shelving. Remove the plain white panels and move the dark metal stair up to the bridge right of the store, as in the reference.

differences.what: The cafe ground floor is underdressed. It has plain yellow spheres instead of round orange lanterns with white flower crests, no warm interior with diners, no red bench, and a weak noren. The koi-nobori fish is on the wrong side and reads as a carrot.
differences.where: Right-center, the cafe storefront under the blue/white awning
differences.fix: Use 7 glowing orange round lanterns with white sakura crests under the awning. Brighten the interior (warm glow, tables, bottle shelves). Add a red bench out front next to the red vending machine and a navy noren with a white drop logo. Move a proper red/orange koi-nobori to the right of the round window at the second floor and add more wisteria and ivy on the balconies.

differences.what: The rain is far too heavy and coarse: large bright white streaks fill the whole frame and cover the scene, while the reference shows only fine, faint rain mainly against the dark sky.
differences.where: Entire frame, worst on the upper right and over the cafe
differences.fix: Cut the streak density by about 70% and the size/length by about 50%, and lower opacity to about 0.2-0.3. Light the drops by nearby sources rather than making them uniformly white, so they are visible mainly against dark backgrounds and near lamps.

differences.what: The right street edge and the skyline lack the reference props and detail. There is no warm street lamp, no yatai stall with a red awning and bottle shelves, and no glowing drink vending machine at the right edge, and the towers are flat dark boxes with random colored dots instead of lit window grids.
differences.where: Right edge midground, and the background towers at upper center
differences.fix: Add a tall black lamp post with a warm head light at the right, a small wooden stall with a red awning, warm interior and menu boards, and a white vending machine with lit bottle rows at the right edge. Give the towers regular warm and cool lit window grids, glass curtain-wall materials and a few neon kanji signs, and fade them into blue-violet haze.
